account_id.description: The account to post to: a leaf account, active.

amount.description: Debit positive, credit negative, in the line's currency.

dimension_value_ids.description: The line's dimension values, at most one of each dimension, each in use (listDimensionValues; DIM-06). An account that requires a dimension needs a value of it on every line of a journal (FR-DIM-01, PRD-001 rev 0.171; DIM-05).

fx_rate.description: Only for a line not in the base currency: base currency per unit of the line's currency, the document's own rate. Left out, the line takes the rate the cascade finds for the journal's date when its checks run and when it posts, with that rate's source, as lookupFxRate shows it; with none anywhere the line has FX-01 (ENG-40; PRD-001 rev 0.71). A base-currency line takes none; posting refuses one (ENG-03).

fx_rate_source.description: Where the rate came from. A rate you send is the document's, so its source is document, set for you when you leave it out; any other source is refused (ENG-03, ENG-40).

origin.description: Only on a director's account: where the amount came from, which decides its tax and accounting result (FR-EQ-01). Required there and refused elsewhere (LEDGER-41).

party_id.description: Only on a director's account (2500, 2120): the director or shareholder the amount belongs to, a contact marked one. Required there and refused on any other account (FR-EQ-01, B.7; LEDGER-41).
